title: switch~
description: set block size and on/off control for DSP

messages.description: nonzero turns DSP on, zero turns DSP off
when turned off, computes just one DSP cycle

body: [switch~] sets the block size, overlap and up/downsampling of the window it is in, like [block~], and can also switch DSP on and off for that window: a nonzero float turns it on and 0 off. While it is off, a bang computes one DSP cycle.
